description:
Goal (separate arc)
Lift the SemanticClosed barrier so DeriveExecutableTransport(E) fires pre-closure, co-settling transport with activations inside the one fixpoint loop. Full realization of the northstar invariant through the backend seam.

What
- Drop the SemanticClosed gate on DeriveExecutableTransport; gate each prerequisite on Current/Settled facts the way derive_runtime_demand waits on current, not settled (jobs/runtime_demand.rs:237-244).
- No new data model: the Stage-2 agreement cell and InputShape contributions already converge on ASCENDING contributors by quiescence, exactly like ActivationInputs (jobs/semantic.rs:205-206). The caller set need not be known up front; it accumulates.
- Retire the seal runtime_demands re-gather seam (jobs/root.rs:302-318) and closure.runtime_demands consumption if nothing else needs the blob.
- Confirm and delete now-dead Cycle/Tarjan and ProjectionMemo if any remnants survive earlier stages.

Risk
Caller-set narrowing: a late caller contribution dropped on a rebased rerun. Guard with the contribution withdrawal-on-rebase semantics (semantic.rs:746-780) and the equivalence harness driven WITHOUT forcing closure first.

Verify
shadow==monolith green; transport facts observed settling before SemanticClosed in telemetry; full matrix + lib green; zero warnings.
title: Stage 4 (arc): lift the SemanticClosed barrier; co-settle transport in the loop
